sn41.4:3.3: See CPD for abbha-sampilāpa. PTS dict wrongly reads samvilapa.
sn41.4:4.6: Text has _therā_ (plural) but this must be merely an artifact of the sandhi with _ti_, as in the previous line he is addressing a single monk.
sn41.4:6.9: By displaying a psychic power, Mahaka had stepped up to and perhaps over the line of behavior suitable for a mendicant. Perhaps he did not want to be seen as currying favor with an influential figure by using his psychic abilities, like Devadatta ([pli-tv-kd17:2.1.12]()).
